title: Environment Protection and Biodiversity Conservation Amendment (Alpine Grazing) Bill 2014
short_title: Environment Protection and Biodiversity Conservation Amendment (Alpine Grazing) Bill 2014

summary.attribution: Written by a model from the explanatory memorandum; not the record
sentences: The bill would stop the proposed cattle grazing trial in Victoria's Alpine National Park by treating it as clearly unacceptable under Commonwealth environmental law.
It would deem the environment minister to have received Victoria's referral and decided the grazing action would significantly affect listed species and ecological communities.
The amendments would commence the day after Royal Assent, requiring notice of the deemed decision and its reasons to be given to Victoria as soon as practicable.
changes: A new section would treat the fire prevention or control grazing proposal as referred for Commonwealth assessment.
The statutory decision would treat impacts on listed species and communities as outweighing the trial's benefits.
The Alpine Sphagnum Bogs and Associated Fens community would be expressly deemed significantly affected.
summary.affected: The Victorian Government, the Commonwealth environment minister and people involved in cattle grazing trials in Alpine National Park would be affected.
